baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus verb at word 1, the causal patience clause at word 3, and the two direct objects at words 4-5.
baseline_models.mechanism: Deliberate self-restraint is the act to which an answering return is matched; the return takes both a spatial form, a tree-covered garden, and a material form, fine silk.

activation_trace.role: Act-matching recompense supplies the reciprocal link between the endured act and its return.
Self-restraint from panic makes patience an active holding of the self rather than mere elapsed suffering.
The tree-covered garden gives the recompense an inhabitable, enveloping spatial form.
Fine delicate cloth gives the recompense a bodily and tactile form alongside the garden.

changed_reading.before: The ayah lists two rewards after patience.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages a matched return: disciplined self-restraint is answered by an environment to inhabit and a fine material to wear.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The semantic tension among patience at word 3, garden at word 4, and silk at word 5.
baseline_models.mechanism: A self held through inescapable pressure is answered by two non-equivalent forms of containment: a cover that protects and a material whose root inventory also evokes freedom. The pair suggests shelter without captivity.

activation_trace.role: Inescapable severity supplies the constricted condition through which endurance persists.
Protective covering turns enclosure into safety rather than confinement.
Freedom opposed to bondage adds a release image beneath the surface sense of silk.
Fine silk keeps the release image anchored to the actual focus noun.

changed_reading.before: Garden and silk are parallel luxury items.
changed_reading.after: Garden and silk form a coordinated answer to constriction: protected enclosure is paired with bodily release and dignity.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The recompense verb at word 1 and the causal construction linking it to patience at word 3.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus can be heard as an account being discharged: patience bears an obligation like surety, recompense settles what is due, and the silk-root inventory contributes the image of a reckoning set straight.

activation_trace.role: Demanding or settling a debt supplies the account-like register of recompense.
Bearing surety or remaining alongside someone casts endurance as sustained liability-bearing.
Setting writing and calculation straight adds an exploratory image of a corrected account while remaining anchored in the silk root.

changed_reading.before: The reward is an unstructured act of generosity.
changed_reading.after: The reward can also be heard as a due account brought to completion after an obligation was faithfully borne.

context_deltas.mechanism: The agents feed others while explicitly declining any return from them; the later divine protection and recompense therefore redirect reciprocity away from vulnerable recipients. The focus recompense can stand in for the payment those recipients were never asked to supply.

activation_trace.role: Standing in and sufficing lets the divine return occupy the place of a return deliberately not collected from beneficiaries.
Bearing surety supports the social mechanism of carrying cost without transferring it back to the dependent recipient.
Giving food to another supplies the unrepaid outward transfer that begins the reciprocal circuit.
Intention and willing make the refusal of a human return an explicit orientation rather than an accidental lack.
The denied return supplies the empty repayment position that the focus recompense later fills.
Protection from harm is the first concrete form of the redirected divine return.
What a person encounters of good or harm turns the return into an experienced reception immediately before the focus recompense.
The later explicit naming of the return closes the redirected circuit as act-matching recompense.

structural_cues: The 76:8-12 sequence moves from feeding dependent people and refusing their return to divine protection and recompense.
The same recompense root appears in the refused human return, the focus divine act, and the later declaration of reward.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies feeding, an intentional refusal of return, divine protection, received good, and repeated recompense language; I infer that the divine return substitutes for repayment withheld from recipients. A live alternative is simple moral juxtaposition without a transferred reciprocal position.

changed_reading.before: God directly pays the patient in a bilateral merit exchange.
changed_reading.after: The focus completes a redirected economy: they give without charging the vulnerable, and God supplies the return from outside that human transaction.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later imperative repeats the focus patience root and locates its restraint within a concrete practice: remain with the Lord's judgment, refuse a competing obedience, and sustain remembrance. Patience becomes governed action rather than passive tolerance.

activation_trace.role: Self-restraint from panic supplies the focus capacity whose practical content is later specified.
Matched recompense makes the specified discipline the behavior to which the return answers.
The repeated command to restrain and remain steady carries the focus quality into an explicit imperative.
Judgment supplies the governing commitment for which the commanded steadiness is maintained.
Obedient submission supplies the rival demand that the negative command tells the addressee to resist.
Repeated vocal mention provides an ongoing practice by which the disciplined stance is sustained.

structural_cues: The 76:24-26 imperatives sequence patience, refusal of obedience, remembrance, prostration, and extended night practice.
The exact patience root recurs after the focus reward scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated patience root, judgment, rejected obedience, and sustained remembrance; I infer that these imperatives specify the behavior compressed into the focus causal clause. A live alternative is that the later commands address a distinct situation and only analogically illuminate the rewarded group.

changed_reading.after: Patience is a disciplined allegiance: holding to governing judgment, withholding corrupt obedience, and maintaining practices that preserve that refusal.

context_deltas.mechanism: Chains, collars, captivity, and blaze establish coercive enclosure and thermal exposure; the garden, shade, absence of thermal extremes, and silk answer them with a designed counter-environment. Its enclosure protects without binding, while its cloth carries a form-distant freedom image without losing the literal silk anchor.

activation_trace.role: Protective cover makes the garden the safe form of enclosure in the reversal.
Freedom opposed to bondage supplies the release pole beneath the focus cloth noun.
Fine silk keeps the release pole attached to the focus's explicit material gift.
A collar that binds a limb supplies the punitive form of bodily enclosure.
Ignited fire supplies the first thermal extreme against which the reward environment is read.
Binding and captivity make release socially concrete in the very person whom the rewarded agents feed.
The sun supplies one excluded environmental exposure.
Severe cold supplies the opposite excluded environmental exposure.
Shade as covering specifies how the garden shelters without becoming a restraint.

structural_cues: The punishment scene in 76:4 joins restraint and heat, while 76:13-14 joins repose, no sun, no severe cold, and nearby shade.
The captive in 76:8 links the rewarded conduct itself to care for someone under restraint.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies binding, fire, captivity, excluded heat and cold, shade, and the focus roots' cover/freedom branches; I infer a deliberate counter-environment of non-coercive shelter. A live alternative is that the details accumulate independent comforts rather than reverse a common exposure system.

changed_reading.before: Garden and silk are detachable emblems of luxury.
changed_reading.after: They jointly redesign the conditions endured: shelter replaces coercive enclosure, balanced cover replaces exposure, and clothing bears a contained image of emancipation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later contrast between loving what is brought forward and abandoning a heavy day gives patience a temporal mechanism: it holds the delayed, weighty consequence in view against immediate attraction. The final will-and-mercy frame prevents the focus causal phrase from becoming a self-funded wage claim.

activation_trace.role: Self-restraint supplies the capacity to resist the temporal pull specified later.
Matched return preserves a real connection between that restraint and the eventual gift.
Heart-attached love supplies the affective pull toward the immediate.
Hastening and bringing forward specify immediacy as the rival temporal horizon.
Leaving something supplies the active abandonment of the delayed horizon.
Weight opposed to lightness explains why the delayed day is difficult to keep present.
Willing directed toward a thing supplies the nested agency frame around taking the delayed path.
Mercy and tenderness qualify the final entry as gift as well as consequence.

structural_cues: 76:27 directly opposes attachment to the immediate with abandonment of a heavy future day.
76:29-31 sequence taking a path, human willing, divine willing, and entry into mercy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the immediate/heavy contrast and the nested will-and-mercy sequence; I infer that patience is temporal resistance and that recompense remains enabled gift rather than autonomous earnings. A live alternative keeps the agency clauses as a general coda that qualifies, but does not define, the focus causality.

changed_reading.before: Patience is generic toughness that earns a later wage.
changed_reading.after: Patience is the sustained refusal to let immediate attraction erase a weighty future, while its matched return still arrives within divine willing and mercy.

context_deltas.mechanism: Precisely fitted vessels, the later explicit declaration of recompense, and acknowledged striving sharpen the focus return from generic abundance into a personally fitted recognition of sustained action.

activation_trace.role: Act-matching recompense supplies the focus relation that later details make more exact.
Agreement with a fitting measure supplies a local image of provision calibrated to its recipients.
The explicit later declaration confirms that the described provision is the act-matching return announced in the focus.
Work and earned activity expand the focus patience clause into a course of purposeful exertion.
Recognition of benefit and praise makes the return acknowledgment, not merely transfer.

structural_cues: The reward description moves from the focus's compact nouns through measured service to a direct declaration that the whole scene is recompense.
The later declaration names their striving as recognized.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fitted measure, repeated recompense, purposeful work, and recognition; I infer that the local exactness of service characterizes the return as personally fitted acknowledgment. A live alternative confines the measuring image to vessel capacity and treats it as unrelated to the logic of reward.

changed_reading.before: The reward is abundant but generic.
changed_reading.after: The reward is an answering recognition whose provisions are portrayed as fitted to the people whose sustained striving is acknowledged.

context_deltas.mechanism: The human begins as mixture, with a packet branch that specifically images interwoven threads, then passes through a test that reveals condition; the focus silk and later clothing permit an exploratory material arc from mixed constitution to ordered fine textile.

activation_trace.role: Fine silk cloth is the explicit focus material to which the earlier thread image can attach.
Steady self-restraint supplies the process maintained through the intervening test.
Interwoven threads convert the initial mixture into a textile-capable material image.
Testing that makes condition appear supplies the transforming interval between mixed origin and bestowed cloth.
Clothing and covering confirm that the focus silk becomes an actually worn state later in the reward scene.

structural_cues: The surah moves from mixed human origin and testing in 76:2 to silk in 76:12 and explicit clothing in 76:21.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mixture, an interwoven-thread branch, testing, silk, and clothing; I infer a material transformation from mixed constitution to ordered textile. A live alternative is that the thread branch is incidental wordplay and the origin and clothing scenes have no causal material relation.

changed_reading.before: Silk is an arbitrary luxury appended to the garden.
changed_reading.after: Silk can carry a contained textile metaphor: the mixed human material that endured disclosure through testing is answered by an ordered, fine, wearable weave.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the packet's non-dominant J-Z-Z split target beneath the focus J-Z-Y verb. It remains worth carrying because harvest-readiness is packet-supplied, the focus immediately names a garden with vigorous-growth potential, and nearby context names fruit whose picking time has arrived. Downstream prose must label it a form-distant harvest overlay or wordplay and must never translate the focus verb itself as harvesting.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The split-mapped focus verb at word 1 and garden noun at word 4, sharpened by the nearby fruit-picking sequence.

activation_trace.role: Readiness for shearing or harvest supplies the explicitly non-dominant, form-distant overlay on recompense.
Thick vigorous growth gives the harvest overlay a focus-local growing medium.
Proximity brings the garden's yield within reach rather than leaving it remote.
The arrival of picking time supplies the ripeness cue that activates the non-dominant harvest image.

changed_reading.before: Recompense is only an exchange made after endurance.
changed_reading.after: As a contained overlay, recompense also resembles a crop reaching its cutting time: patience is maturation, and the garden's now-near yield is the harvest.

strongest_changes: The refused human recompense in 76:9 turns the focus into redirected reciprocity: divine return stands in for payment never demanded from vulnerable recipients.
The repeated patience imperative in 76:24 specifies endurance as disciplined allegiance, rejected corrupt obedience, and sustained remembrance.
The punishment and reward environments recast garden and silk as shelter without coercion and as a response to thermal and bodily exposure.
The immediate-versus-heavy contrast makes patience temporal resistance, while will and mercy keep recompense from becoming autonomous wage logic.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet made the compact focus ayah function as a hinge: prior unrepaid care is answered by divine recompense, later imperatives disclose the practice inside patience, and later material details unfold garden and silk into a fitted counter-environment. Split-root and cross-material branches also preserved two contained discoveries, the harvest overlay and the movement from interwoven mixture to fine cloth.
remaining_uncertainties: The substitute-payer mechanism is strongly sequenced but remains a reader-supplied directional relation rather than an explicit statement of transfer.
The freedom branch beneath silk is form-distant and should qualify the literal cloth rather than replace it.
The fitted-measure image may apply only to vessels, not to recompense as a whole.
The mixture-to-textile and split-root harvest readings are exploratory wordplay-level activations, not lexical disambiguations.
